description: Extract structured JSON from a page using AI. Provide a prompt and/or a response_format JSON schema to guide extraction. Costs 5 credits per successful extraction.

browser.description: Browser that renders the page. Omit to use the default Chrome browser. Set to "kitesurf" to use the Kitesurf browser engine.

prompt.description: Natural-language instruction for what to extract

response_format.description: Optional JSON-schema response format to constrain the output

name: get_url_json
